articles.title: Selena Gomez's Sweet London Surprise: Dessert Tray Dance!
articles.summary: Selena Gomez is in London filming a new season of her show, and she kicked it off by doing a silly dance with a dessert tray. Wait until you see what she pointed at!

articles.title: Supercharge Your YouTube: 5 Cool Browser Tricks You'll Love
articles.summary: Did you know you can make YouTube way more fun with free browser add-ons? These five extensions let you change colors, hide annoying Shorts, and even make the screen glow around videos.

articles.title: Kali Uchis Rides a Carriage Onstage and Teases a New Album!
articles.summary: Kali Uchis started her For the Girls tour in Chicago by arriving in a carriage, just like a princess. She also told us she has a whole new album ready, and it's in Spanglish!
